description: Zig HTTP/1.1 server on the zix.Http1 raw engine, .URING dispatch: per-worker SO_REUSEPORT accept plus io_uring loop, comptime Router with a staged send sink, gzip negotiation, prewarmed static cache. Dual listener: cleartext 8080 plus https TLS 1.3 on 8081. async-db and crud go through the postgrez and rediz drivers with worker-owned connections, crud reads are cache-aside via the Redis sidecar.
